Calculates how long it takes to double investment, assuming stock sells at the same rate as restock rate and factoring overall lead time. Lower number indicates better cashflow.

Example: Product A has 100% ROI, 100 days lead time, doubling their investments every 100 days.

Product B has 50% ROI, 40 days lead time, doubling their investments every 80 days even with lower ROI. Days to double ROI
